name: @pryzm/typology-pack-office-building
description: Office building (tower) typology pack. The fourth generative typology, a peer to casa-unifamiliar + apartment + residential-building: a tall stack of circular floor plates around a centred core (lifts + stairs + MEP + WCs), with concentric open-plan desk rings, perimeter offices / collaboration pods at the glass, and department/floor-type variety (amenity ground, sky-lobby, mechanical/refuge floors, executive top). Ships the C50-compliant TypologyManifest + the stories/floor-to-floor/radius/desk-density/culture brief + a GATED (default-OFF) bridge TypologyStageBundle. The circular floor-plate orchestrator lives in @pryzm/ai-host (workflows/officeBuilding).
